Accrued interest = face × coupon × (days from last coupon to settlement under the convention) / (year basis of the convention: 360 for ACT/360 and 30/360, 365 for ACT/365). ACT counts actual calendar days; 30/360 counts every month as 30 days (a day 31 is treated as day 30).
